paths.description: Homepage: primary market/news dashboard and global navigation archetype.
Domestic market listing/index template; represents dense tabular market discovery.
Samsung Electronics stock detail; represents quote, chart, financial tables, and detail navigation.
Main news listing; represents content/index pages.
Stock search for 삼성전자; representative public task flow from query to result/detail.
Deliberately invalid route used to judge failure messaging and recovery.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot remains a white light theme, and the DOM reports color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide dark surface, text, border, chart, and image treatments through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Tab and route state changes swap abruptly with no View Transition support.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero view-transition CSS rules; KRX/NXT state changes are immediate.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for tab/state changes and cross-document transitions for compatible navigation, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Global menus and transient layers use fixed absolute positioning rather than anchored semantic primitives.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS in the DOM artifact positions GNB layers absolutely with fixed widths; the probe found zero popover, dialog, or details primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover/dialog semantics and CSS anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks for transient menus and help layers.

findings.summary: Mobile receives a scaled-down desktop canvas instead of a responsive layout.
findings.evidence: All five 360x800 layout captures report no viewport meta and a 980 CSS-pixel layout viewport. Mobile screenshots show tiny three-column desktop content scaled to 36.7%.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standards-based viewport meta tag, replace fixed-width desktop wrappers with intrinsic fluid layouts, and reflow tables/charts into mobile-appropriate components.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their available container.
findings.evidence: The probe found zero @container rules, while screenshots show the same fixed multi-column composition at desktop and mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards, market tables, and sidebars containment and use size-aware container queries to recompose them.

findings.summary: The scaled desktop layout creates pervasive undersized touch targets and poor zoom/reflow.
findings.evidence: The probe measured 133 of 150 visible interactive elements below 24px in at least one dimension; the missing viewport meta causes mobile scaling rather than reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow at narrow widths and provide at least 44x44 CSS-pixel touch areas around controls and links without disabling zoom.

findings.summary: The document lacks semantic landmarks and has accessibility labelling gaps.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero main, nav, header, or ARIA landmarks and three unlabelled form controls. Lighthouse failed landmark-one-main.
findings.suggestedFix: Structure the shell with header/nav/main/footer landmarks, retain the logical heading hierarchy, and label every form control programmatically.

findings.summary: Some text and essential interface colours do not meet WCAG contrast minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s color-contrast audit failed across multiple nodes on the representative home page.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise muted text, tab, status, and control contrast to WCAG AA while preserving market-direction semantics with non-colour cues.

findings.summary: Cold-load performance is slow under Lighthouse mobile conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 5.2s, LCP 7.7s, TBT 460ms, Speed Index 10.7s, and Time to Interactive 18.5s (performance score 0.46). A separate trace measured LCP 2.65s and one 56.9ms long task.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP path, defer non-critical scripts and ad/analytics work, and split long main-thread tasks by user-visible priority.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking legacy resources and large unused bundles delay delivery.
findings.evidence: HAR captured parser-inserted blocking styles and scripts among 75 requests. Lighthouse estimated 1,763KiB unused JavaScript and 104KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer or module-load non-critical scripts, remove unused/duplicate bundles, subset CSS per template, and keep critical dependencies short.

findings.summary: Asset and document hygiene includes distorted chart images and an obsolete desktop document model.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found five chart images displayed at 50x30 despite a 120x60 intrinsic ratio. DOM evidence shows EUC-KR and fixed-width legacy CSS; Lighthouse also reports BFCache blocked by no-store responses.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve intrinsic image aspect ratios, migrate templates to modern UTF-8 semantic HTML, and review no-store usage so safe public pages can use BFCache.

findings.summary: The public finance portal is blocked from general crawling and is not mobile-friendly.
findings.evidence: robots.txt says User-agent: * Disallow: /, Lighthouse fails is-crawlable, and all audited templates omit viewport metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish an intentional crawler policy for public pages, align robots and sitemap coverage, and add a correct viewport meta tag.

findings.summary: Page metadata is incomplete and inconsistent across templates.
findings.evidence: The home page has title “Npay 증권” but no meta description. Recon found no canonical URL, and the raw home HTML did not preserve the rendered title/H1 signals.
findings.suggestedFix: Add unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions to each archetype, plus canonical URLs and consistent server-rendered heading/title signals.

findings.summary: HTTPS is present, but core security headers and cookie attributes are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP or X-Content-Type-Options. Cookies evidence found JSESSIONID and NACT without Secure and all six cookies using SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, nosniff, secure SameSite cookie defaults, and audit whether cross-site cookie access is actually required.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policy coverage is weak.
findings.evidence: The main response lacks clickjacking protection, Permissions-Policy, and CSP; Referrer-Policy is unsafe-url, which sends full URLs to destinations.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options), a restrictive Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; add Trusted Types where XSS-sensitive DOM sinks remain.

findings.summary: The page has a broad multi-origin analytics, advertising, and asset footprint.
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 68 of 75 requests and 601,101 of 664,756 transferred bytes to origins other than finance.naver.com; tracker recon lists eight third-party origins, though none matched the built-in known-tracker list.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory each cross-origin dependency, remove non-essential telemetry/ads, batch analytics, defer low-value work, and document data purpose and retention.

findings.summary: The primary stock search explicitly disables browser autocomplete.
findings.evidence: Recon shows the labelled query input uses autocomplete="off".
findings.suggestedFix: Use a suitable autocomplete token or allow browser history where appropriate; keep site suggestions as an enhancement rather than disabling input assistance.

findings.summary: Image delivery relies on legacy formats and eager below-fold assets.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found seven legacy PNG/GIF images, no modern formats, four missing responsive sources, and four below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP where suitable, lazy-load below-fold charts/assets, and retain intrinsic dimensions and useful fallbacks.

taskList.title: Rebuild the public templates as responsive, accessible layouts
Cut the critical rendering path and unused JavaScript/CSS
Harden response headers, cookies, and cross-origin data collection
Repair crawler, canonical, description, and structured metadata
Modernise document, image, and BFCache hygiene
Replace fixed custom layers with semantic anchored primitives
